Bash(python3 -c "
import re

files = [
    'McCarthy2026_1_GraphNecessity.tex',
    'McCarthy2026_2_Escalation.tex',
    'McCarthy2026_3_Normalization.tex',
]

pattern = r'<<<<<<< HEAD\\n\(.*?\)\\n=======\\n\(.*?\)\\n>>>>>>> [a-f0-9]+\\n?'

for fname in files:
    with open\(fname, 'r'\) as f:
        content = f.read\(\)
    
    before = content.count\('<<<<<<< HEAD'\)
    resolved = re.sub\(pattern, lambda m: m.group\(2\) + '\\n', content, flags=re.DOTALL\)
    after = resolved.count\('<<<<<<< HEAD'\)
    
    with open\(fname, 'w'\) as f:
        f.write\(resolved\)
    
    print\(f'{fname}: {before} -> {after} conflicts'\)
")
